verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents a Live mode in which developers stream binary PCM16 or Opus audio over a WebSocket. It returns partial Captions and completed transcript items as speech is processed, and the API reference catalogs a Live Scribe WebSocket operation. The live session also supports in-stream session.update events, for example to swap vocabulary mid-session. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time latency and behavior, and partial-result Captions are still in preview.
